run_wer_cli: run the WER script to compute unit error rate from hypothesis and reference transcription files
compute_wer_function: compute word error rate between reference and hypothesis transcriptions using edit distance
load_tra_function: load transcription files into a dictionary mapping utterance IDs to their transcriptions
get_parser_function: build an argument parser for the WER script with hypothesis and reference file arguments
review_compute_wer_g2p: review the compute_wer function to understand grapheme-to-phoneme processing and edit distance calculation
